claim: The standard fibration has generic fibers 2 III* + 6 I1 and trivial Mordell-Weil group.
The alternate fibration has generic fibers I8* + 2 I2 + 6 I1 and Mordell-Weil group Z/2Z.
The base-fiber-dual fibration has generic fibers II* + I2* + 6 I1 and trivial Mordell-Weil group.
The maximal fibration has generic fibers I10* + 8 I1 and trivial Mordell-Weil group.
The heterotic Narain lattice is the even unimodular lattice Lambda^(2,18)=H+H+E8(-1)+E8(-1).
The four quartic-to-Weierstrass coefficient maps and their discriminants are independently compiled symbolically.
A complete algorithm mapping every paper fibration branch to explicit heterotic Wilson vectors in the frontend basis is available.
